description: Firewalls and filtering systems do not implement a default deny rule, allowing traffic that is not explicitly permitted rather than blocking all traffic except what is specifically allowed. This signal indicates that network traffic control follows a permissive rather than restrictive security model.
applicability: This signal applies to: Host-based firewalls Network firewalls and ACLs Security groups (cloud environments) Web application firewalls Packet filtering systems Network access control lists Endpoint protection platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Review CIS compliance documentation and controls for CONFIG requirements.
